title: How to Fold an Origami Crane | Step-by-Step Tutorial
description: Learn how to fold the classic origami crane with easy step-by-step instructions for beginners.

schema.name: How to Fold an Origami Crane
schema.description: Fold the classic origami crane in 7 steps using one square sheet of paper.

supply.name: One square sheet of origami paper

step.name: Fold and unfold diagonally
step.text: Fold your square paper in half diagonally, then unfold. Repeat along the other diagonal so both creases are visible.

step.name: Fold in half both ways
step.text: Fold the paper in half horizontally and unfold, then vertically and unfold, leaving four creases crossing in the center.

step.name: Collapse into a square base
step.text: Using the creases as guides, bring the corners together and collapse the paper into a smaller square shape.

step.name: Fold up the sides
step.text: Fold the left and right edges of the top layer inward to the center line, forming a kite shape. Repeat on the back.

step.name: Petal fold the wings
step.text: Lift each flap upward and flatten it into a petal fold to form the crane's wings on both sides.

step.name: Shape the head and tail
step.text: Fold one narrow point down slightly to create the head using a reverse fold, and leave the other as the tail.

step.name: Finish
step.text: Gently pull the wings apart and curve them for a finished look.

title: How to Fold an Origami Heart | Easy Step-by-Step Tutorial
description: A quick, easy origami heart tutorial, perfect for cards, gifts, and bookmarks.

schema.name: How to Fold an Origami Heart
schema.description: Fold an easy origami heart in 6 steps using one square sheet of paper.

supply.name: One square sheet of origami paper, colored on one side

step.name: Fold in half
step.text: With the colored side down, fold your square in half vertically, then unfold to leave a center crease.

step.name: Fold the top corners down
step.text: Fold the top two corners down to the center crease, forming a triangle shape at the top.

step.name: Fold the bottom point up
step.text: Fold the bottom point up to meet the base of the triangle, creating a pentagon-like shape.

step.name: Round the top lobes
step.text: Fold the top two corners inward and slightly downward to round them into the heart's two lobes.

step.name: Tuck and flip
step.text: Tuck the bottom point behind the lobes slightly to sharpen the heart's shape, then flip the paper over.

step.name: Finish
step.text: Flatten all the creases firmly. Your origami heart is ready to use as a card topper, bookmark, or gift tag.

title: How to Make an Origami Penguin | Step-by-Step Tutorial
description: Fold an easy origami penguin in 10 steps with our free diagram and written instructions. A beginner-friendly project that needs just one square of paper.

schema.name: How to Make an Origami Penguin
schema.description: Fold an easy origami penguin in 10 steps using one square sheet of paper. No scissors or glue required.

supply.name: One square sheet of origami paper

step.name: Start with a square sheet
step.text: Use a square piece of origami paper. If your paper is two-toned, start with the darker colour facing down — this will become the penguin's back.

step.name: Fold in half diagonally
step.text: Bring one corner up to meet the opposite corner, forming a triangle. Crease firmly along the fold, then unfold back to a flat square.

step.name: Unfold
step.text: Open the paper back out flat. You now have a diagonal crease running corner to corner.

step.name: Fold both sides to the centre crease
step.text: Fold the left and right corners inward so their edges meet along the diagonal crease in the centre, forming a kite shape.

step.name: Fold the bottom point up
step.text: Take the bottom pointed tip and fold it upward so it meets roughly the centre of the shape.

step.name: Fold up the smaller triangle
step.text: Fold the small triangle at the top downward slightly to form the penguin's head, leaving a small strip showing for the face.

step.name: Fold the entire shape in half
step.text: Fold the whole shape in half vertically (mountain fold), bringing the right side behind the left.

step.name: Fold the head back at an angle
step.text: Rotate the head forward at a slight angle using an inside reverse fold to create the beak.

step.name: Fold the base flaps down
step.text: On each side, fold the bottom corner flaps downward and outward to form the penguin's flippers.

step.name: Finish
step.text: Stand your penguin upright, adjust the base so it balances, and add a dot for the eye.
